name: Omarchy PWS Weather
author: Omarchy port based on work by Rafal Liwoch and Kevin Donnelly
description: Weather Underground PWS observations with a stationless Open-Meteo fallback for the Omarchy bar.

barWidget.description: PWS observations, hourly outlook, and seven-day forecast

schema.label: PWS station ID
schema.description: Case-sensitive personal weather station ID, used when a Weather.com API key is configured.

schema.label: Weather.com API key
schema.description: Your Weather Underground/Weather.com API key. Leave empty to use the Open-Meteo location mode.

schema.label: Meteoblue API key (optional)
schema.description: When set, Meteoblue replaces the default keyless Open-Meteo forecast. It stays in the local Omarchy shell configuration.

schema.label: Traveling mode
schema.description: Use public-IP geolocation to select a nearby active PWS instead of the home station.
